items.quote: Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 2 Mar 2026, posted by an authority → deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG = Fri 6 Mar 2026 (no weekend/holiday shift applies to the delivery-fiction day itself). The one-month objection period (§ 70 Abs. 1 VwGO) starts the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, i.e. on the same-numbered day, Mon 6 Apr 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). That day is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tue 7 Apr 2026 (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG).
